content: We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. But we have no SMILES or description. We need to get data. Possibly we need to retrieve IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch? Or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons. But we need the compound identity. The prompt doesn't give SMILES. Maybe the system expects we can query something? There is no tool to get structure. Perhaps the compound is "the sample at hand" meaning there is a hidden sample. We can use IR spectra tool to detect C=O stretch. That would indicate number of carbonyl groups. Use ir_spectra.
